reviewNotes: Revision delta vs draft 0002. (a) Restored source findings F3, F4, F5, F6, F7, F8, F9, F10 (8 scope requirements bundled into a single F3 in draft 0002) with their original per-bullet sourceRefs and intra-finding relations. (b) Restored source findings F14, F15, F16 (distinction, terminology, authority constraints bundled into a single F7 in draft 0002). (c) Restored source findings F17 and F18 as separate entries (orientation research boundary and artifact-safety boundary bundled into a single F8 in draft 0002). (d) Restored source findings F19-F28 (the 10 acceptance-criterion bullets bundled into a single F9 in draft 0002). The consolidations in draft 0002 were not tied to any reviewer correction and removed complete relevant source coverage, so they are reverted; coverage is preserved by discrete, source-anchored findings rather than a target count. (e) Removed F32 (draft 0001) / F13 (draft 0002), the interpretation-nondeterminism risk finding. The reviewer instructed that this material risk is already represented by canonical RSK-5 in authoritative .newfang/project.json; the in-normalized-match mechanism in src/domain/intake.ts (normalizeForMatch: lowercase, collapse whitespace, strip trailing punctuation) is conservative and does not treat F13's paraphrased wording ('...the guarantees that canonical truth reflects the reviewed interpretation') as identical to RSK-5's wording ('...the only guarantees that canonical truth is correct'), so calling it an exact duplicate is internally inconsistent -- the apply preview would create a new risk rather than skipping one. Treating the match as a semantic or paraphrased duplicate and omitting the risk finding removes the inconsistency and ensures the apply preview creates zero new risks. (f) Removed draft 0001's F34 (open question about whether revision requests need a durable record). The reviewer instructed that this is no longer an open question; it is implemented policy, and F33 records the implemented decision with citations to the design, source, tests, and the actual reviews.jsonl records for INT-8. (g) Kept the F12 distinction (draft 0002) that focusWorkItemId is NF-2 and NF-3 appears only in the next-action text -- promoted to F31 in this draft, restated in proposedNextActionRationale. (h) Kept the F15 locked decision (draft 0002) about durable revision records -- renumbered to F33 in this draft. Every model_inference that asserts current repository or canonical state names the authoritative artifact actually checked (intake manifests, .newfang/project.json, src/state/intake-store.ts, docs/design/PLANNING_INTAKE.md, test/intake.revision.test.ts, .newfang/intakes/INT-8/reviews.jsonl); unchecked possibilities are not stated as current facts. Stage only; apply is not requested.
